name: mdx-harness-provider-gateway
policy_rules: missing or disabled profiles fail closed
a live profile without an ACCEPTED turn-on observation for exactly its provider denies with live_provider_turn_on_evidence_missing
an accepted observation for one provider never unlocks another - evidence is per-provider, never global

an observation-backed live profile is SELECTABLE; selection records provider_connected_observed=true and the turn_on_observation_receipt_id, and still places no call (live_provider_call_allowed=false)
rejected observations stay visible with their denial reason and unlock nothing
budget, retention, redaction, and provider fail-closed behavior are policy fields
enterprise packs may narrow behavior but cannot widen trust boundaries
enterprise pack contracts are enforced during provider selection
manifest enterprise pack mismatches fail closed with denied provider receipts
local enterprise packs cannot enable audit export before observed export proof

acceptance_requires: credential presence only - no secret values
turn_on_bridge.call_authority: selection is readiness, never call authority - live call execution is the plan-execute loop's own later slice

forbidden_capabilities: no provider secrets in generated artifacts
no prompt or output text in receipts
no project-local widening of trust boundaries
no execution authority from provider selection
